title: Rock Paper Sock
description:
Coming soon - Grunn!

Об игреRock Paper Sock is a realtime, online rock paper scissors game & chill zone!

Features
• Play rock paper scissors against sheep, farmers, dragons, other players, and more!

• 4+ hours of gameplay.

• 50+ items to collect.

• 10+ enemies to battle.

• Customise your own character with cool gear.

• Level your rock, paper, and scissors levels.

• Hang out and chat with other players.

• A mysterious wizard stuck in a mysterious crystal.

• Cool graphics.

Controls
• Left mouse button to interact.

• Right mouse to inspect.

• Arrow keys to rotate the camera.

• The rest of the keyboard to chat!

Note:
A working internet connection is required to play this game!
description_short: A rock paper scissors MMO. Battle sheep, dragons, and other players. Collect cool gear, and become a rock paper scissors master!
